05 / GOOD QUESTIONS

A little clarity.

Can we start with just one service?+

Absolutely. Start with a specific need, from a content batch to an SEO review. We’ll agree the deliverables and fee before we begin.

What does a project cost?+

Every brief is different. Share your goals, scope and budget, and Mohammed will put together a project-specific proposal. No invented packages or surprise commitments.

Are you a new agency?+

Yes. Lugia International is a new agency. We’re building our story through thoughtful work, clear proposals and direct communication. We don’t present unverified results or borrowed client stories.

Who will I speak with?+

Mohammed Dalvi is your point of contact for the brief, project coordination, feedback and handover.
